apiBase.title: semaje server URL
apiBase.description: Base URL of your semaje server, e.g. https://semaje.example.com

apiKey.title: API key
apiKey.description: Org-issued semaje API key (smj_...). Leave unset for SSO/single-user servers.

language.title: Default spoken language
language.description: Any semaje language code or alias (sw, kik_Latn, yo). Empty = auto-detect.

lockSettings.title: Lock managed settings
lockSettings.description: When true, users cannot change any value set by this policy.
